A1.justification: Despite the changed title, both PDFs describe the same QAE research and contain all 19 pages, including Appendices A and B. Text, equations, tables, and figures support reliable comparison. A localized table overlap in v2 does not prevent recovery of its contents.

before.justification: v1 reports original Qwen3 training experiments, mathematical reasoning benchmark results in Table 2, masking ablations in Figure 6, and additional empirical analyses in Appendix B.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark results, ablations, and training diagnostics in the main text and Appendix B. Retention from v1 does not change their status as original empirical results.

M1.justification: Section 4 retains the same empirical K-quantile baseline, standardized advantage, and two-regime gating of successes and failures. The proposed objectives and update procedure are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use DAPO-Math-17K for training and AIME'24, AIME'25, and AMC'23 for evaluation. No dataset, task, domain, or distinct test scenario is added or removed, including in Appendix B.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains Clip-Higher, CLIP-Cov, KL-Cov, and GSPO with their QAE variants. The Clip-Higher controls and POS-MASK/NEG-MASK comparisons also remain unchanged. The added related-work citation is not a new evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: Both specify zero-shot evaluation with 32 completions per query, temperature 0.7, and pass@1/pass@16 metrics. Training configurations, clipping settings, masking experiments, and the K sweep in Appendix B are unchanged.

E4.justification: Both retain the clipping sweep, positive/negative masking ablations, entropy decomposition, token diagnostics, K sensitivity analysis, and model-scale training comparisons. Figure 7's added phase labels redisplay an existing analysis rather than introduce a new one.

E5.justification: Neither version reports training-seed counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting procedure is added or revised; the 32-completion evaluation sampling setting is also unchanged.

E6.justification: The numerical entries in Tables 1 and 2 and the plotted results are unchanged. For example, both report AIME24 pass@1 of 39.69 for Qwen3-8B Clip-Higher and 48.23 with QAE. Figures 7 and 11 retain the same data despite presentation edits.

T1.justification: The quantile definitions, objective derivation, entropy-covariance reasoning, and Propositions 4.1 and 4.2 are unchanged. Appendix A retains the same assumptions, equations, and proofs.

C1.justification: The main claims remain quantile-based entropy regulation, two-regime entropy safety, sparse credit assignment, and improved reasoning performance. Although the title changes and the abstract drops explicit model names, the introduction retains the same model scope and contributions.

C2.justification: The entropy mechanism, sample-efficiency interpretation, K-selection guidance, and stated limitations remain the same. Deleted explanatory phrases in Sections 3.2 and 5.2 repeat interpretations still present in the introduction and Figure 5 caption.

D1.justification: Appendix B.1 retains the same implementation settings, and the QAE code and VERL script links are unchanged. The new computing-center acknowledgment supplies no additional hardware configuration, runtime, or reproduction instructions.

R1.justification: Section 7 adds Mroueh (2025) and reorganizes existing entropy research into mechanistic, objective-level, and recipe/system-level strands. It more explicitly positions QAE as filling a gap in data-adaptive baseline control, without substantially expanding the literature coverage.

P1.justification: The title, affiliation and correspondence details, and running headers change; acknowledgments are added and one related-work paragraph is rewritten. Limited deletions introduce incomplete wording, including 'gains on across' in the abstract and 'penalty against to regularize' in Section 2.

P2.justification: Figure 7 gains phase annotations, and Figure 11 is restyled with '14B'/'14B_ours' replacing 'DAPO'/'+ QAE' in its legend. Local spacing and page flow change. In v2, surrounding prose overlaps Table 1's final row, reducing readability.

improvement.justification: The clearer related-work organization and added citation offer modest benefits, but v2 introduces Table 1/text overlap and incomplete wording in the abstract and GRPO description. These defects reduce readability and precision while the scientific evidence and theory remain unchanged, producing a limited overall decline.
